statement: The matched-qutrit comparator uses Hq=chi(Z1+Z2)(|e><e|+|f><f|), initial (|g>+|f>)/sqrt(2) and Tq=pi/(2chi), giving conditional unitary -Z1Z2. A dominant f-to-e decay at any time continues the matched interaction; no-jump Kraus operators I+/-exp(-gamma_f*T/2)S also preserve both parity sectors. At chi=2g its coherent time pi/(4g) versus 8/g is not a complete wall-time comparison. Matching, heating, second decay, Ramsey operations, readout and reset are paid. Established coherent erasure, pulse shaping, finite emptying, flying-cat, Bacon-Shor, path-independent control and bosonic/dual-rail work retain credit. The physical operating window still has to earn longitudinal access, bandwidth, temperature, calibration, lifetime and repeatable reset against those strong alternatives. The separate monitored fixed-four-photon CLY Kerr construction and degree-5/6 static number-polynomial bounds remain within their own code/actuator class. Fourfold shorter CZ and fourfold photon number cancel in integrated exposure 2pi/chi versus dual rail; monitoring and recovery are not free.
